report.summary: Both failures are the same test-side bug: the page object clicks a test id `add-books`, but the app's button is `add-book`, so Playwright times out waiting for a locator that never exists. Fix `tests/support/pages.py:44` first; the two tests should then reach their real assertions.

causes.title: Page object uses test id 'add-books' but the app renders 'add-book'
causes.explanation: BooksPage.add() clicks get_by_test_id("add-books"), but the Add button in the books template has data-testid="add-book". No element in the app uses "add-books", so the click waits the full 5s and times out before any behavior is exercised. The app is correct here; the locator in the test support code is wrong. Both failing tests call BooksPage.add(), which is why they fail identically. The other book UI tests do not click this button, which is consistent with them not failing.
evidence: Failure call log: "waiting for get_by_test_id(\"add-books\")" with Timeout 5000ms exceeded, raised from tests\support\pages.py:44 via tests\ui\test_books_ui.py:13 and :42
search_code for 'add-books' finds only tests/support/pages.py:44; no app template defines it
causes.suggested_fix: Change tests/support/pages.py:44 to get_by_test_id("add-book"). Optionally make the page object reference the same id the template uses, so a rename is caught in one place. Then rerun tests/ui/test_books_ui.py to confirm the real assertions run.
